cash_and_initial_funding_review.opening_convention: 50.839B liquid assets is a Dec2026 planning forecast from Sep2026 cash+STinvestments54.005B and selectedQ4flows. It is not measured current cash. cash_and_initial_funding_review.economic_treasury: Cash is after cash-equivalent SBC and minority reserves. It is an owner budget, not an exact bank statement or peak quarterly liquidity model. cash_and_initial_funding_review.floor: Do not automatically subtract the20B liquidity floor as an extra valuation claim. Cash that earns a fair return still has value; required cash can be modeled in operating working capital instead, but the model must then reconcile the cash-income treatment.
cash_and_initial_funding_review.method_finding: Operating DCF excludes investment income when cash is separately valued. Cash’s value depends on its reinvestment return and restrictions; merely calling it operating cash does not make it valueless.
cash_and_initial_funding_review.other_assets: The5.717B other-assets net balance uses carrying-value proxies. Entire8.798B nonoperating equity exposure equals about1.60/share before any tax/claim effects; the base does not mark private investments to realizable sale proceeds.

capital_identity_review.finding: From2031, capex=DA+net_operating_investment−WC. Consequently DA cancels from operating cash at a fixed EBIT forecast. The grosscapex line is a decomposition of the selected net-investment rule, not an independent capacity calculation.
capital_identity_review.implication: The20%-of-Products DA path, margin path and useful asset lives need a coherent physical interpretation. A simple all-equipment8-year straight-line comparison gives higher DA than the model, but buildings, installation lags, grants and intangible/lease scopes prevent declaring this an error. No arbitrary capex correction is selected.
capital_identity_review.R_and_D: R&D is expensed within operating profit and not capitalized in the investment denominator. A consistent R&D capitalization would adjust operating earnings, taxes and invested capital together while preserving cash value; the current23.5% ratio should be labeled an implied accounting/net-investment return.
